_about: EV-012 cases for plan kensaku-v1-1 (product card content from the extended /answer schema). P01 and P02 are real /answer responses from the kensaku-v1-1 spike (V1: SG, schema with keySpecs and reason; V8: US, the reason description also says 'Do not mention prices or currency amounts'). P03 is the MVP spike's A2 response, which predates keySpecs and reason, so it pins backward compatibility with cached answers and stored history.
labelStatus: Assistant-proposed expected values derived by hand from the frozen citation rule (evals/cases/citations.json 'rule') and the keySpecs rule below. They become gold only when the owner approves plan kensaku-v1-1.

rules.keySpecs: Trim each string; drop empty strings and strings longer than 80 characters; drop exact duplicates keeping the first; keep at most 5, in Exa's order. A missing or non-array keySpecs yields [].
rules.reason: A string reason is rendered with resolveCitations(reason, citationUrls) using the same citations as the comparison (the EV-004 rule, unchanged). A missing, non-string, or whitespace-only reason yields no reason section (null).
rules.noPriceInCard: Card prices come only from merchant offers. The reason text is research text and is shown as written by Exa; the /answer schema asks Exa not to mention prices (V8 shows it complying), but Kensaku does not edit the text.
